_README: This file drives the Projects section on the homepage.
While 'projects' is empty, the site shows the 'Our list moves every week'
enquiry panel instead of an empty grid. Nothing is broken — that is deliberate.
Add real entries below and the filterable grid appears automatically, with
filter buttons generated from whichever 'segment' values you have used.
Every field except 'name' is optional; blank rows are simply not rendered.
Do not invent figures. Anything published here should be verifiable, because
a wrong price or possession date on a public page is a problem you own.
name          Project name, as the developer markets it        (required)
type          Apartment | Villa | N.A. Plot | Shop | Showroom | Office
price         e.g. On request  /  Rs 1.45 Cr onwards
